d: Short, sleek slate-blue hair with straight bangs and a slight side-part, paired with narrow, almond-shaped turquoise eyes and a neutral, youthful expression. A slender, adolescent build wearing a dark navy blue winter dress with a white faux-fur trim, a gold waist belt, and a matching navy capelet. The outfit is accented by white thigh-high stockings, dark brown boots with gold detailing, and a small snowman plush held in one hand. Long, upright white rabbit ears emerge from the top of the head.
